observed_execution_evidence.note: The pre-existing reused-root preflight state is observed evidence for the frozen runner. It is not evidence that setup.py itself or the fresh download/cache branch was exercised. The full replay was ongoing during this review.

resolved_findings.finding: Pinned Mathlib Cache.IO.validateCurl invokes curl even before any fallback; the initial setup and README omitted this prerequisite.
resolved_findings.resolution: Fresh Mathlib setup now checks curl >=7.81 and README lists it.

resolved_findings.finding: Inherited MATHLIB_CACHE_DIR/GET_URL and default HOME/XDG cache could redirect or reuse cache inputs outside the claimed fresh checkout.
resolved_findings.resolution: All MATHLIB_CACHE_* variables are removed and a newly created, explicit cache directory beneath --external-dir is used and documented.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial prerequisite lookup used inherited PATH while child commands used a sanitized system PATH and bare python3.
resolved_findings.resolution: System tools are checked in the actual child PATH, README states those paths, and the preflight child uses sys.executable with an explicit >=3.9 check.

scope: Bounded independent static review of setup.py and reproduction README, against the frozen runner, dependency pins, existing reused-root preflight state, and the pinned Mathlib cache implementation. No setup execution, replay execution, network download, cache population, cache mutation, or frozen proof-input edit was performed by this review.
